title: Les Métallos appuient le projet de loi visant à fermer une échappatoire dans la loi anti-briseurs de grève et à renforcer le droit de grève des travailleuses et travailleurs
author: Syndicat Des Métallos
description: The United Steelworkers union supports a new bill introduced by NDP MP Don Davies to close a loophole in federal anti-scab legislation. The loophole allows employers to use outside managers as replacement workers during labor disputes. The union highlighted a Rogers strike in Abbotsford, BC involving 25 technicians where managers crossed picket lines to perform bargaining unit work, undermining strike protections.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Rogers is criticized for exploiting a loophole in anti-scab legislation by using outside managers to perform bargaining unit work during a 4.5-month strike, undermining worker protections and prolonging the labor conflict.

title: What Might Be Behind One Fund's New $40 Million Bet on Rogers Corporation Stock?
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: ACK Asset Management LLC acquired 436,707 shares of Rogers Corporation for approximately $40 million in February 2026, making it a 5% position in the fund. Rogers, a supplier of engineered materials for EVs and wireless infrastructure, has gained 25% over the past year. The investment reflects confidence in the company's margin durability and exposure to EV and aerospace recovery, though the company currently trades below historical peak margins.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong recent performance with 25% gain over the past year, improving Q3 financials (6.5% sequential sales growth, margin expansion to 33.5%, adjusted EPS jump to $0.90), positive cash flow generation, and a significant $40M institutional investment signal confidence in future margin durability and exposure to growing EV and aerospace markets.

title: Why Rogers Stock Jumped 17% This Morning
author: Anders Bylund
description: Rogers, an engineered materials company, reported Q3 2025 earnings of $0.90 per share, beating analyst expectations of $0.69. The company saw double-digit sales growth in industrial, electric vehicle, and aerospace segments, leading to a significant stock price increase.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q3 earnings performance, beating analyst expectations, with growth in key market segments and potential leadership stability under interim CEO Ali El-Haj

title: Rogers Hosts World Series Watch Parties for Games Three & Four @ Rogers Centre
author: Globe Newswire
description: Rogers is offering watch parties at Rogers Centre for Blue Jays World Series games against the Los Angeles Dodgers, with $15 tickets and proceeds going to Jays Care Foundation. Free tickets will be available for Rogers customers through their Beyond the Seat program.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Actively supporting their team, offering fan experiences, and contributing to charity through ticket sales

title: Bring it Home: Rogers World Series Ticket Giveaway for Fans and Customers Starts Today
author: Rogers Communications
description: Rogers is offering free World Series tickets to fans through various promotional methods, including social media contests and customer rewards, to support the Toronto Blue Jays' World Series campaign.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively engaging fans through multiple ticket giveaway initiatives, demonstrating strong customer appreciation and brand marketing strategy
